goal: Prevent interleaved log streams when running multiple chainstate contexts or kernel library instances
Allow kernel consumers and multi-context tests to cleanly separate log output by context
agreement: Thinks review cost and merge conflicts outweigh current user demand, favoring simpler logging (stickies-v)
Earlier objection about cumbersome logger plumbing was resolved with per-file enforcement (stickies-v)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it eliminates process-wide global logging state from the kernel library
Enables clean concurrent execution of multiple independent chainstate contexts in one process
Provides architectural leverage for making the kernel usable as an isolated library

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it decouples general logging primitives from mandatory global singletons
Provides modular logging sinks without altering behavior for standalone executables
